items.name: ub-mode
items.readme:
# ub-mode

`ub-mode` is an agent skill that enforces disciplined software engineering principles when writing or changing code. It is loosely based on portions of [@poteto](https://github.com/poteto)'s rules (`poteto-mode` / `pstack`), reduced and paired with deterministic quality-gate tools:

1. **First Make it Work** — Laziness Protocol, Foundational Thinking, TDD, Redesign From First Principles, Attack the Premise, Subtract Before You Add, Outcome-Oriented Execution, Build the Lever, and Architecture (Model the Domain, Boundary Discipline, Type System Discipline, Make Operations Idempotent, Separate Before Serializing Shared State).
2. **Then Make it Right** — Fix Root Causes, Sequence Work into Verifiable Units, Test Behavior (Not Implementation), [Crapper](https://github.com/unclebob/crapper) (`CRAP < 10`), [Dryer](https://github.com/unclebob/dryer) (duplication `< 0.8`), [Mutator](https://github.com/unclebob/mutator) (cover the uncovered, kill the survivors, delete dead code), and Refactoring.
3. **Practice** — Keep a Log, Guard the Context Window, Worktree Cleanup, and Commit and Push in small ordered commits.

## Companion Tool Repositories

`ub-mode` relies on deterministic quality-gate tools to enforce structure, complexity, duplication, and test thoroughness:

- [unclebob/crapper](https://github.com/unclebob/crapper) — Computes cyclomatic complexity, test coverage, and CRAP score per function so every function stays under the CRAP threshold (`< 10`).
- [unclebob/dryer](https://github.com/unclebob/dryer) — Detects structural code duplication so duplicate blocks (`>= 0.8` similarity) are eliminated.
- [unclebob/mutator](https://github.com/unclebob/mutator) — Runs mutation testing to expose uncovered code and surviving mutants that tests fail to catch.
- [unclebob/uml-viewer](https://github.com/unclebob/uml-viewer) — Visualizes components, coverage, CRAP, mutation scores, and dependency directions.

## Installation

Copy `SKILL.md` into your agent's skills directory as `ub-mode/SKILL.md` (for example `~/.grok/skills/ub-mode/SKILL.md`, `~/.claude/skills/ub-mode/SKILL.md`, or `~/.cursor/skills/ub-mode/SKILL.md`), then invoke `/ub-mode`.

items.readme:
# AI Pose Gallery · 中文版

> 288 组 / 1439 张 AI 人体姿势参考图，日文数据完整汉化，附可直接部署的响应式静态画廊。

![画廊预览](docs/preview.jpg)

<details><summary>手机端预览</summary>

![手机端预览](docs/mobile.jpg)

</details>

**在线演示：** <https://ai-pose-gallery.anhao.app/>
**原始站点：** <https://ai-pose-gallery.pages.dev/>
**原作者：** ギア（@giaaibusi）
**中文版维护：** Anhao · [X @anhao_ai](https://x.com/anhao_ai)
**GitHub：** <https://github.com/anhao/ai-pose-gallery-zh>

---

## 这是什么

原站是一套面向 AI 绘画 / 3D / 摄影参考的姿势图库，元数据全部为日文，且不提供批量素材下载。本仓库做了三件事：

1. **全量镜像** —— 1439 条记录对应的 1439 张缩略图（JPG 300×400）与 1439 张原图（PNG 900×1200）全部落地，共 2878 个文件 / 659.5 MB。
2. **完整汉化** —— 日文字段逐条译为中文，覆盖 4 个体系、26 个分类、288 个姿势名、5 个视角，零遗漏。
3. **可用的前端** —— 零依赖响应式画廊，完整实现原站的分类筛选、多角度切换、分组浏览、灯箱导航与原图下载，并针对手机重新设计布局。

## 页面功能

- 4 个体系页签，显示各体系的图片数与姿势组数
- 姿势名、编号、ID、分类关键词搜索，支持 `/` 快速聚焦
- 动作分类、5 种视角组合筛选，可一键重置
- **按姿势分组 / 逐张浏览**双模式，分组卡片带多角度缩略图
- 悬停或点击缩略图切换主图角度，点击卡片打开灯箱
- 灯箱先显示缩略图、再加载 900×1200 原图，支持直接下载 PNG、复制 ID、新窗口打开
- `← / →` 切换角度，`↑ / ↓` 切换姿势，`Esc` 关闭；手机支持左右滑动
- PC 多列网格、手机双列网格，移动端筛选面板可展开/收起
- 使用指南与注意事项弹窗，页脚标注图片来源与维护者链接

## SEO 与分享

页面内置了完整的 SEO 与社交分享配置：

- 关键词化标题：`AI 姿势参考库｜288 组人体姿势 · 1439 张多角度参考图`
- 独立 description、keywords、author 与 `max-image-preview:large`
- `canonical` 指向正式域名，避免自定义域名与 pages.dev 域名重复收录
- Open Graph / Twitter Card 使用 1200×630 的 `og-cover.jpg`
- JSON-LD 结构化数据：`WebSite` + `ImageGallery`，声明语言、简介与页面主图
- `robots.txt` 放行全站并声明 sitemap，`sitemap.xml` 指向首页
- 语义结构：单一 H1、分区 H2、卡片 H3；缩略图 `alt` 含姿势名与视角，图片懒加载

仓库中的绝对地址统一指向 `https://ai-pose-gallery.anhao.app/`。Fork 后如使用其他域名，需同步替换 `index.html` 的 canonical、`og:*`、`twitter:*`、JSON-LD，以及 `robots.txt`、`sitemap.xml` 中的地址。

## 数据规模

| 体系 | 条数 |
| --- | ---: |
| 全身单人・标准系 | 365 |
| 全身单人・性感系 | 399 |
| 上半身单人 | 400 |
| 双人缠绵 | 275 |
| **合计** | **1439** |

每条记录对应 5 个视角中的若干个：正面 / 斜侧 / 侧面 / 俯视 / 仰视。

## 目录结构

```
.
├── index.html              # 单页画廊（零依赖，直接打开即可）
├── robots.txt              # 搜索引擎抓取规则
├── sitemap.xml             # 站点地图
├── og-cover.jpg            # 1200×630 社交分享封面
├── data/
│   ├── pose.json           # 原始日文数据（1439 条，未改动）
│   ├── pose-zh.json        # 中文数据（前端实际读取，含检索字段）
│   ├── meta.json           # 原始体系分类
│   ├── meta-zh.json        # 中文体系分类
│   └── translations.csv    # 日⇄中对照表（323 条，便于校对）
├── thumbs/                 # 缩略图 1439 张 JPG 300×400（22 MB）
├── img/                    # 原图 1439 张 PNG 900×1200（637 MB）
├── scripts/
│   ├── download.py         # 并发下载器（48 线程 / 断点续传 / 自动重试）
│   ├── i18n.py             # 日译中词典（唯一值去重后的 323 条译文）
│   ├── apply_translation.py# 回填译文，生成中文数据
│   ├── verify.py           # 校验文件完整性（存在性 / 大小 / 图片头）
│   └── build.sh            # 生成 Cloudflare Pages 发布目录 dist/
├── docs/                   # README 页面预览图
├── _headers                # Cloudflare Pages 缓存策略
├── LICENSE
└── README.md
```

## 数据结构

`data/pose-zh.json` 字段说明：

| 字段 | 原日文字段 | 示例 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | — | `full_sexy_P001_front` | 唯一标识 |
| `体系` | `系統` | 全身单人・性感系 | 4 大类 |
| `姿势编号` | `ポーズ番号` | `P001` | 80 组编号 |
| `分类` | `分類` | 站姿 | 26 类动作 |
| `姿势名称` | `ポーズ名` | S形站姿・胯部侧顶 | 288 种描述 |
| `角度` | `アングル` | 正面 | 5 种视角 |
| `缩略图` | `サムネ` | `thumbs/…jpg` | 相对路径 |
| `原图` | `原寸` | `img/…png` | 相对路径 |
| `检索` | — | 拼接串 | 供前端模糊搜索 |

原始日文数据 `data/pose.json` 保持原样，字段名与站点接口一致，便于对照或回灌。

## 本地预览

画廊通过 `fetch` 读取 JSON，需要 HTTP 环境（直接双击 `index.html` 会被 CORS 拦截）：

```bash
python3 -m http.server 8000
# 打开 http://127.0.0.1:8000
```

页面支持体系/分类/视角组合筛选、关键词搜索、分组与逐张浏览、多角度缩略图、懒加载、灯箱原图下载、键盘与触屏导航。

## 脚本用法

```bash
# 重新拉取全部图片（已存在的文件自动跳过，可反复执行）
python3 scripts/download.py
WORKERS=64 python3 scripts/download.py   # 调整并发

# 修改 scripts/i18n.py 中的译文后，重新生成中文数据
python3 scripts/apply_translation.py

# 校验 2878 个文件是否完整
python3 scripts/verify.py
```

## 部署到 Cloudflare Pages

仓库为纯静态站点，无框架、无依赖。

**方式一：GitHub 自动部署（推荐）**

1. 登录 Cloudflare Dashboard → **Workers & Pages** → **Create** → **Pages** → **Connect to Git**
2. 选择本仓库 → 生产分支 `main`
3. 构建设置照抄：

   | 字段 | 值 |
   | --- | --- |
   | Framework preset | `None` |
   | Build command | `bash scripts/build.sh` |
   | Build output directory | `dist` |

4. **Save and Deploy**，约 2–5 分钟得到 `https://<project>.pages.dev`
5. 之后每次 `git push` 自动重新发布

> ⚠️ **不要**把 Build output directory 直接填 `/`。仓库根目录含 `.git`（数百 MB），
> Cloudflare 会把它当静态资源扫描，pack 文件超过 25 MiB 单文件限制会导致构建失败。
> `scripts/build.sh` 只拷贝 `index.html`、`_headers`、`data/`、`thumbs/`、`img/` 到 `dist/`。
> 若确实想用根目录，仓库已附 `.assetsignore` 兜底排除非站点文件。

> 站点限制：单文件 ≤ 25 MiB、每次部署 ≤ 20,000 个文件。本仓库最大文件 917 KB、共 2883 个文件，均在限制内。

**方式二：命令行直传**

```bash
bash scripts/build.sh
npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name ai-pose-gallery-zh
```

`_headers` 已为 `img/`、`thumbs/` 配置一年期强缓存，图片不会重复回源。

## 内容提示

图库包含成人向姿势参考（部分分类名称涉及性行为术语），仅供艺术创作、动作参考与前端技术学习使用。请勿用于违法用途。未成年人请勿访问。

## 版权与致谢

- **图片与原始数据的著作权归原作者ギア所有**，来源地址见页首
- 本仓库仅为个人学习、汉化与静态站点实践存档，**不对图片主张任何权利**，也不构成对原作品的商业使用授权
- 若原作者认为本仓库侵犯其权益，请通过 Issue 联系，将立即删除相关内容
- `scripts/` 与 `index.html` 的代码以 MIT 协议开源（见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)），该协议**不覆盖** `img/`、`thumbs/` 与 `data/` 中的图片和原始数据

items.name: Zero-Breach-Toolkit
items.description: Free, open-source, offline checks for traces of known mercenary spyware. Works on Windows, macOS and Linux, Android phones and iPhone backups.
items.readme:
# Zero Breach Toolkit

A free, open-source check for traces of known mercenary spyware (Pegasus, Predator,
Graphite, Candiru and others) on computers, Android phones and iPhone backups.

- **Read-only.** It does not modify source evidence or system settings. It writes only
  temporary database snapshots and the reports you ask for.
- **No network requests during a scan.** It never looks up spyware addresses and has no
  upload feature. Python network calls are blocked and redirected paths are refused. This
  is not an operating-system network sandbox; see [PRIVACY.md](PRIVACY.md).
- **States its limits.** Every report says what was found, how strong the evidence is, and
  what could not be checked. A clean result is never presented as proof that you are safe.

Made by archivegenocide. Built on [Zero Breach](https://github.com/interplains/zero-breach).

> **If you think you are being targeted right now, get expert help first.** You do not
> need to run this tool before asking. Journalists, activists, human-rights defenders and
> civil society can contact the
> [Access Now Digital Security Helpline](https://www.accessnow.org/help/) (free, 24/7,
> many languages) or [Amnesty International's Security Lab](https://securitylab.amnesty.org/get-help/).

---

## Step-by-step guide (no technical experience needed)

You do not need a GitHub account or any technical knowledge. You need a Windows or Mac
computer and about 20 minutes. Phones are checked by connecting them to the computer.

**What do you want to check?**
[This Windows computer](#windows) ·
[This Mac](#mac) ·
[An Android phone](#android-phone) ·
[An iPhone](#iphone)

### Windows

**Set up (only the first time)**

1. Go to [python.org/downloads](https://www.python.org/downloads/) and click the yellow
   **Download Python** button. Open the downloaded file.
2. On the first screen of the installer, **tick "Add python.exe to PATH"** at the bottom,
   then click **Install Now**. Wait until it says "Setup was successful".
3. On this page, click the green **Code** button near the top, then **Download ZIP**.
4. Open your **Downloads** folder, right-click **Zero-Breach-Toolkit-main.zip** and choose
   **Extract All**, then **Extract**.

**Run the check**

5. Close your web browsers and chat apps (Chrome, Edge, WhatsApp, Signal…).
6. Open the **Zero-Breach-Toolkit-main** folder (if there is another folder with the same name
   inside, open that one too), then the **scan** folder, and double-click **run-scan.cmd**.
   If Windows shows a warning, click **Run** (or **More info**, then **Run anyway**).
7. A menu appears. Type the number next to **Update the indicator lists** and press Enter,
   then type `y` and press Enter. When it finishes, press Enter.
8. Press Enter again to start **This computer - standard check**. It takes about 15 minutes.
9. Read the result at the end (see [What the result means](#what-the-result-means)). A copy
   is saved in the **findings** folder inside Zero-Breach-Toolkit-main.

### Mac

**Set up (only the first time)**

1. Go to [python.org/downloads](https://www.python.org/downloads/), click **Download Python**,
   open the downloaded file and follow the installer. When it finishes, open **Finder →
   Applications → Python 3** and double-click **Install Certificates.command** (without it,
   updating the indicator lists fails).
2. On this page, click the green **Code** button, then **Download ZIP**. It appears in your
   **Downloads** folder as **Zero-Breach-Toolkit-main** (if it is still a .zip file,
   double-click it).
3. Open **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Full Disk Access**, click **+**, choose
   **Applications → Utilities → Terminal**, and turn it on. Without this, macOS hides
   Safari's records from the check.

**Run the check**

4. Close your web browsers and chat apps.
5. Open **Terminal** (press Cmd+Space, type `Terminal`, press Enter). Copy this line, paste it
   into Terminal and press Enter:
   ```
   cd ~/Downloads/Zero-Breach-Toolkit-main && python3 -X utf8 scan/zero-breach-toolkit.py
   ```
6. A menu appears. Type the number next to **Update the indicator lists** and press Enter,
   then type `y` and press Enter. When it finishes, press Enter.
7. Press Enter again to start **This computer - standard check**. It takes about 15 minutes.
8. To keep a copy of the result, type `3` and press Enter, type `report.txt` and press Enter.
   It is saved in the Zero-Breach-Toolkit-main folder. Type `0` to finish.

On Linux, follow the Mac steps without step 3.

### Android phone

First do the **Set up** steps for [Windows](#windows) or [Mac](#mac) above.

**On the phone**

1. Open **Settings → About phone** and tap **Build number** seven times, until it says you are
   a developer. (On Samsung: **Settings → About phone → Software information → Build number**.)
2. Go back to **Settings**, open **Developer options** (often under **System**) and turn on
   **USB debugging**.
3. Connect the phone to the computer with a USB cable that carries data (some cables only
   charge). Unlock the phone. When it asks **Allow USB debugging?**, tick **Always allow** and
   tap **Allow**.

**On the computer**

4. Start Zero Breach (Windows: double-click **run-scan.cmd**; Mac: step 5 of the Mac guide).
5. In the menu, type the number next to **A phone** and press Enter, then type `2` (**Collect
   from an Android phone connected by USB now**) and press Enter.
6. Press Enter to save the collection on your Desktop, then type `YES` and press Enter.
7. The collector asks a few questions. Use the arrow keys and Enter to answer:

   | It asks | Choose |
   |---|---|
   | Backup | **Only SMS** |
   | Download copies of apps | **Only non-system packages** |
   | Remove copies of apps signed with a trusted certificate | **No** |
   | Intrusion Logs | **No** |
   | Hash files | **No** |
   | Anything else | **No** |

8. If the phone shows **Back up my data**, tap it (leave the password empty). Keep the phone
   unlocked until the collection finishes.
9. The check starts by itself and shows the result.
10. When you are done, turn **USB debugging** off again on the phone.

### iPhone

First do the **Set up** steps for [Windows](#windows) or [Mac](#mac) above.

1. **Make a backup on the computer.** Connect the iPhone with a cable and tap **Trust** on the
   phone.
   - Windows: install **Apple Devices** from the Microsoft Store, open it and select the iPhone.
   - Mac: open **Finder** and select the iPhone in the sidebar.
2. Choose **Back up all of the data on your iPhone to this computer**, tick **Encrypt local
   backup**, choose a password you will remember, and click **Back Up Now**. Wait until it
   finishes.
3. **Open the backup folder:**
   - Windows: press **Windows key + R**, paste `%USERPROFILE%\Apple\MobileSync\Backup` and press
     Enter.
   - Mac: in Finder, choose **Go → Go to Folder**, paste
     `~/Library/Application Support/MobileSync/Backup` and press Enter.

   Inside is a folder with a long name of letters and numbers: that is your backup.
4. Start Zero Breach. In the menu, type the number next to **A phone**, press Enter, type `1`
   and press Enter.
5. **Drag the backup folder** (the one with the long name) into the Zero Breach window and press
   Enter.
6. When asked whether the backup is password-protected, type `y` and press Enter, then type the
   backup password (nothing appears while you type) and press Enter.

### If something goes wrong

| What you see | What to do |
|---|---|
| `'python' is not recognized` or nothing happens on Windows | Run the Python installer again, choose **Modify**, and make sure **Add Python to environment variables** is ticked. Restart the computer. |
| `No such file or directory` on a Mac | The folder has a different name. In Terminal type `cd ` (with a space), drag the Zero-Breach-Toolkit-main folder into Terminal, press Enter, then run `python3 -X utf8 scan/zero-breach-toolkit.py`. |
| `command not found: python3` | Install Python from python.org (step 1), then close and reopen Terminal. |
| Updating the indicator lists fails on a Mac (`CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED`) | Open **Finder → Applications → Python 3** and double-click **Install Certificates.command**, then update again. Full Disk Access does not affect updating. |
| Android: the collector finds no phone | Unlock the phone, use a different cable or USB port, and check **Allow USB debugging** was accepted. Unplug and plug in again. |
| iPhone: "wrong password" | Use the password chosen when **Encrypt local backup** was first turned on. If it is forgotten, it can be reset on the iPhone (Settings → General → Transfer or Reset iPhone → Reset → Reset All Settings), then make a new backup. |
| Safari "could not be checked" on a Mac | Give Terminal Full Disk Access (Mac step 3), close Terminal, open it again and run the check again. |

Still stuck? Ask in the [issues](https://github.com/interplains/Zero-Breach-Toolkit/issues)
(do not post your report there; it contains private details).

### What the result means

- **"No known indicators found"**: nothing from the published spyware lists was found in
  the places the tool could check. It is not proof that the device is clean: read the list
  of places that could not be checked.
- **"Something matched"**: this means *look closer*, not *you are infected*. Do not delete
  anything and do not visit the address it names. Keep the report and contact the
  [Access Now Digital Security Helpline](https://www.accessnow.org/help/) (free, 24/7).
- The report never leaves your computer unless you send it to someone yourself.

---

## What it checks

### Windows

No administrator rights are needed.

| Where | What it looks for |
|---|---|
| Browsers at their default locations: Chrome, Edge and Brave (including beta, dev, canary and nightly channels), Chromium, Vivaldi, Opera, Opera GX, Arc, Yandex; Firefox, LibreWolf, Waterfox, Floorp, Zen, Pale Moon, Tor Browser | indicator addresses in history, cookies, connection records, HSTS, bookmarks, downloads, site storage and caches, per profile |
| Desktop apps with a built-in Chromium browser | supported history, cookie and storage records; raw app web caches are skipped and reported as a gap |
| Downloaded files | the website each file came from (the "Mark of the Web" stamp) |
| The Win+R box | commands people were tricked into pasting by fake "verify you are human" pages |
| Antivirus status and Microsoft Defender history | registered antivirus products and their reported status; past Defender detections, protection-off events and added exclusions |
| PowerShell log | scripts that named a spyware address, or downloaded and ran code |
| Programs listed by Windows | existing files named in the shim cache and the Windows 11 launch list, compared with published sample fingerprints; not a complete execution history |
| Prefetch and Amcache | supported Prefetch executable-name records and Amcache file inventory; the program files they name are never opened |
| Selected user folders | fingerprints of candidate files, within size and directory limits |
| DNS cache, DNS history, hosts file, COM and startup/task/service registrations | known indicators in supported network and persistence records; not a full persistence audit |

A Prefetch match (`execution-record`) does not identify the file's contents or full path;
an Amcache match (`inventory-record`) does not prove execution or that the file still
exists. Locked or unsupported records are gaps.

Antivirus status comes from Windows Security Center, including third-party products such
as Bitdefender that register there. An active registered product puts an old Defender-off
event in context; it does not mean protection is off now. Registration is not a health
test, some enterprise products do not register, and unavailable status is a gap. A desktop
app such as Slack is listed because its web records were checked, not because it is
suspicious.

The default hash check covers `.dll`, `.exe`, `.sys`, `.ocx`, `.cpl`, `.scr`, `.tmp`,
`.dat`, `.bin` and `.ax` files up to 120 MiB in selected folders, skipping cache and
dependency directories. Computer checks can find published infrastructure or file traces;
they cannot tell whether a phone is infected.

### macOS and Linux

The same browsers are checked at their default locations, plus common Snap and Flatpak
packages and Firefox's newer `~/.config/mozilla` profile folder on Linux. On a Linux desktop
in another language, the translated Downloads, Desktop and Documents folders are found from
`user-dirs.dirs`. File fingerprints, separate browser cache locations and bounded saved-record
checks run without administrator access.

- **Safari (macOS):** history and profile databases, open and iCloud tabs, the URL cache,
  WebKit's tracking-prevention list, cookies, HSTS records, bookmarks, downloads, Top Sites
  and recently closed tabs.
- **Startup configuration:** on Linux, standard autostart `.desktop` entries, systemd units
  and immediate `.conf` overrides, cron configuration and scheduled script directories; on
  macOS, standard LaunchAgent and LaunchDaemon property lists. A launch item's program is
  compared as an executable path and, by its file name, as a process name.
- **Shell and logs (both):** standard shell startup files, saved Bash/Zsh/fish history
  (including macOS Terminal's per-session history in `~/.zsh_sessions`), the hosts file and
  readable current text system logs. Paths inside `$( )` and backticks are recognised. Large
  history and log files are limited to recent records; the omitted part is a gap.

These read saved configuration, not which jobs are enabled or ran. Network strings are
references; exact known executable paths in supported launch configuration can be
findings, with activation and execution unverified.

File checks also cover extensionless files, executables, native libraries and scripts in
selected application, user and temporary folders (120 MiB limit). Windows-only live checks
do not run here; copied Prefetch and Amcache files can still be selected in targeted mode,
though compressed Prefetch needs Windows.

### Desktop apps

Apps with a built-in Chromium browser are found by their folder contents under AppData
(Windows), Application Support (macOS) or the user and Flatpak configuration folders
(Linux), including apps whose own folder is a Chromium profile, such as Signal on macOS.
The search has no fixed depth limit; it is bounded by folder count and time, and reaching
that bound is reported as a gap.

### Android

The tool reads a collection made with [AndroidQF](https://github.com/mvt-project/androidqf);
it never talks to the phone itself. It checks:

- installed and running apps, their fingerprints and signing certificates;
- the install history, so an app that was installed and later removed still shows;
- system records, logs and crash records;
- supported, already decrypted intrusion logs: DNS lookups, TCP connection attempts and
  process-start events (a connection attempt does not prove success);
- links in SMS and MMS messages, from the SMS backup AndroidQF offers to take;
- apps installed outside an app store, with what they can do (read SMS, use the
  microphone, read notifications, resist uninstalling) and when they arrived;
- signs of a modified phone: unlocked bootloader, debug build, security protection off.

It recognises the collection's own traces (USB debugging, the debugging shell's
permissions) and does not report them as suspicious.

### iPhone

Local Finder, Apple Devices or iTunes backups (encrypted or not), extracted file systems
and sysdiagnose archives. See
[Checking local iPhone evidence](#checking-local-iphone-evidence).

### Indicators

About 12,400 published indicators from 29 sources: Amnesty International's Security Lab,
the [Mobile Verification Toolkit](https://github.com/mvt-project/mvt-indicators) project,
the Citizen Lab and Echap's stalkerware research, and a hand-curated set from Citizen Lab
reports (Candiru / DevilsTongue and Paragon's Graphite) with every line cited. The curated
set works offline; `--update` downloads the rest from a fixed list of official sources.

---

## Install and run

You need Python 3.8 or newer ([python.org](https://www.python.org/downloads/); on Windows,
tick "Add python.exe to PATH" when installing). No administrator rights and no extra
packages. On macOS and Linux type `python3` instead of `python`.

1. **Get the toolkit.** On GitHub choose **Code → Download ZIP** and extract it, or:
   ```
   git clone https://github.com/interplains/Zero-Breach-Toolkit.git
   ```
2. **Open a terminal in the toolkit folder.** Windows: open the extracted
   folder (`Zero-Breach-Toolkit`, or `Zero-Breach-Toolkit-main` from a ZIP), click the address bar, type `powershell` and press
   Enter. macOS: open Terminal, type `cd ` (with a space), drag the folder into the window
   and press Enter. Run every command below from this folder.
3. **Recommended: download the latest indicator lists.** This is optional and is the only
   step that uses the internet; the checks themselves never do. Without it only a small
   built-in set is used. Repeat it every few weeks.
   ```
   python -X utf8 scan/zero-breach-toolkit.py --update
   ```
4. **On a Mac, give Terminal Full Disk Access first** (System Settings → Privacy & Security
   → Full Disk Access → add Terminal, then reopen it). Without it macOS blocks Safari's
   records and some folders, and the report lists them as not checked.
5. **Close your browsers and chat apps**, then run the check. A menu opens; press Enter for
   the standard check of this computer.
   ```
   python -X utf8 scan/zero-breach-toolkit.py
   ```
   On Windows you can instead double-click `scan\run-scan.cmd`. It saves the readable and
   JSON reports in a `findings` folder next to the toolkit.

Reports contain private details from your computer; keep them out of shared and synced
folders. Useful options:

```
python -X utf8 scan/zero-breach-toolkit.py --quick                     # faster: skips file fingerprints
python -X utf8 scan/zero-breach-toolkit.py --phone "FOLDER"            # a phone collection or backup
python -X utf8 scan/zero-breach-toolkit.py --json report.json          # machine-readable report
python -X utf8 scan/zero-breach-toolkit.py --share-json summary.json   # minimal summary for sharing
```

Put folder paths in quotes, especially if they contain spaces. On Linux or macOS,
`sh scan/run-scan.sh` takes the same options.

### Verify what you run

The project is anonymous, so do not take its word for anything. Verification rests on what
you can reproduce.

Running from source, as above, means every line the tool executes is in the clone: nothing
is compiled and nothing is fetched in order to run.

The single-file `zero-breach-toolkit.py` attached to a release is generated from the same
source. Rebuild it from the release's tag and compare:

```
git checkout v0.1.9
python build/bundle.py
python -c "import hashlib; print(hashlib.sha256(open('dist/zero-breach-toolkit.py','rb').read()).hexdigest())"
```

For v0.1.9 the file is 966,469 bytes, SHA-256
`8574f7e701bc64e459a2c19f28f8192f0c9d286ed900c95f1ed57a074fb2e828`. The size and SHA-256
published with each release are authoritative. The build is deterministic, so a matching
rebuild means the published file contains that source and nothing else. Releases are also
GPG-signed; see [docs/VERIFYING.md](docs/VERIFYING.md).

There is no signed Windows program, and none is planned while the project stays anonymous:
code-signing certificates require a named legal identity. An `.exe` you build yourself with
PyInstaller is unsigned, has no download reputation and is not byte-reproducible, so
SmartScreen will warn, some antivirus products will flag it, and the comparison above does
not apply. Running from source avoids all of that.

### Checking an Android phone

1. On the phone, turn on *Developer options* (Settings → About phone → tap *Build number*
   seven times), then turn on *USB debugging*.
2. Connect the phone by USB and tap *Allow* when it asks about this computer.
3. Download and run [AndroidQF](https://github.com/mvt-project/androidqf/releases) on the
   computer. Answer its questions like this:

   | AndroidQF asks | Answer |
   |---|---|
   | Take a backup of the device? | Only SMS |
   | Download copies of all apps or only non-system ones? | Only non-system packages |
   | Remove copies of apps signed with a trusted certificate? | No |
   | Take the Intrusion Logs? | No, unless you turned on Intrusion Logging |
   | Hash files on the device? | No (Yes also checks file fingerprints, but it is slow and can stop the collection on some phones) |
   | Browser history / Magisk modules? | No |

   On the phone, confirm the backup with *Back up my data*.
4. AndroidQF saves a `.zip` next to itself. Extract it.
5. From the toolkit folder, check the extracted folder (keep the quotes):
   ```
   python -X utf8 scan/zero-breach-toolkit.py --phone "PATH TO THE EXTRACTED FOLDER"
   ```
   Or run the tool with no options, choose *A phone*, and drag the folder into the window.
6. Turn USB debugging off again.

The collection holds private information about the phone. Keep it on your computer.

Use `--phone-guide android` for preparation steps and `--phone FOLDER --preview` to list
which artifacts are available. For an AES-encrypted `backup.ab`, add `--backup-password`;
the password is asked for privately at the terminal and never appears as an argument or in
a report. Age-encrypted acquisition archives must first be decrypted with the owner's
identity using the separate age tool; this scanner does not launch it.

**Guided acquisition (experimental).** `--collect-android LOCAL_OUTPUT_FOLDER` downloads
official AndroidQF v1.8.3, checks its pinned SHA-256, asks for the device owner's explicit
consent and runs the collector's interactive prompts. After a successful plaintext
acquisition it extracts the archive locally and checks the collection. Acquisition changes
phone state and saves private records; it is separate from read-only scanning.

This is the only point at which the tool runs a program it did not ship:

- the asset name and expected digest are fixed in the source;
- the file is fetched over HTTPS from the publisher's release, with redirects limited to an
  allow-list, and hashed while downloading;
- if the digest does not match, acquisition is refused and nothing is executed;
- the collector is written to a temporary directory and run directly, not through a shell,
  with `ADB_`, `ANDROID_ADB_`, `LD_` and `DYLD_` variables removed and `PATH` reset to the
  system directory, then deleted when the command finishes;
- nothing is downloaded or run unless you invoke the command and confirm consent.

The pinned digest verifies the publisher's release bytes; it is not an independent audit of
the collector. The publisher ships the Windows build unsigned, so a browser download shows
the usual "not commonly downloaded" warning and SmartScreen prompts on first run. If you
prefer, install AndroidQF yourself, follow the five steps above and skip this command.

`--age-recipient-file PATH` supplies public age1 recipients (private identity files are
refused). When encryption is requested, a plaintext result is refused. An encrypted result
must have a supported age envelope and no unexpected extra files, but these format checks
cannot authenticate it or verify the recipient. It is saved for separate decryption; the
command succeeds without producing a scan or an all-clear. After a failure, check the
reported folder: original or partial records are kept and may be unencrypted.

### Checking local iPhone evidence

1. Make a local backup with Finder (Mac) or Apple Devices / iTunes (Windows). Tick
   *Encrypt local backup*: encrypted backups include more of the records this tool checks.
2. Find the backup folder (one per device, with `Manifest.plist` inside): on a Mac
   `~/Library/Application Support/MobileSync/Backup/`, on Windows
   `%USERPROFILE%\Apple\MobileSync\Backup\`.
3. From the toolkit folder (keep the quotes; leave out `--backup-password` if the backup
   is not encrypted, and the password is asked for privately):
   ```
   python -X utf8 scan/zero-breach-toolkit.py --phone "PATH TO THE BACKUP FOLDER" --backup-password
   ```

`--phone-guide ios` and `--phone-guide android` print these steps in the terminal.

Encrypted backups need the optional `cryptography` package already installed in your Python
environment; nothing is installed automatically. Install it with
`python -m pip install --require-hashes -r requirements-backups.txt` (every package pinned by
version and hash). The supported version is cryptography 50.0.2, which needs Python 3.9 or
later. Intel Macs get 48.0.1, the last release published for them; its remaining advisories
concern certificate checking, which this tool does not use.

For evidence you already have, use `--phone ROOT --ios-input filesystem` for an extracted
file system, or `--phone PATH --ios-input sysdiagnose` for a directory or TAR/TAR.GZ archive.
Both are also in the phone menu. This does not acquire a device.

It reads messages (SMS, iMessage, WhatsApp), Safari and other browsers, data-usage
processes, app records, permissions, calls, calendar, interactions, Shortcuts,
configuration profiles, analytics and diagnostics (shutdown logs, crash and memory reports,
running processes, installation logs). Local browser visits are separated from synced or
imported ones; unknown origin stays a reference with a gap. Unusual paths alone are leads.

Committed SQLite WAL records, including encrypted backup sidecars, are validated and
replayed on temporary copies. JSON findings keep source hashes and record locators. While a
table's row index is readable, an unreadable message, visit or process row is skipped and
later rows are still checked; repeated gaps are grouped. Unsupported encodings or schemas,
damaged WALs, record caps, unavailable protection classes and encrypted `Manifest.db` WALs
are gaps. The test suite covers the table layouts
of iOS 15, 16, 17 and 18. See [docs/IPHONE.md](docs/IPHONE.md) for exact support and limits.

### Choosing the scope

- `--scan-type default` uses the computer checks and file candidates supported on your platform.
- `--scan-type full` also reads desktop-app raw web caches and hashes all file extensions
  in the usual roots, including subdirectories normally skipped. It is broader, not a scan
  of every drive, account or artifact. The 120 MiB file limit remains.
- `--scan-type targeted --target PATH` reads only the selected files, directories, drives
  or browser profiles; repeat `--target` for several. Selected files are hashed whatever
  their extension, within the same size and access limits. Copied Prefetch/Amcache files
  inside the selection are also read. Live registry and log checks are outside this scope.
- `--scan-type browser` reads only this account's browser profiles and desktop apps with a
  built-in Chromium browser (history, cookies, site storage, caches and connection records)
  against every loaded list, including ad-campaign addresses. Large caches can take several
  minutes. Files, startup entries, DNS, registry and system events are not read.
- `--preview` prints the proposed scope without scanning. File hashing reports progress.
  Ctrl+C stops the scan and reports what was collected, with an incomplete-coverage gap.
- `--extended-windows` adds existing Sysmon and Security process events. It does not enable
  logging or elevate privileges. If access is denied, a second run from an administrator
  terminal can read what the ordinary account could not.

On Windows, saved console and Explorer input is also read; it does not prove that anything
ran. Startup checks interpret recognisable batch commands, Internet Shortcut URLs and literal `.lnk` target and
argument metadata, without resolving or opening the target; anything they cannot interpret
is a gap. Related-record groups link the same indicator across artifacts with their dates
and original grades; they do not claim a causal attack sequence. Publisher validity,
platform and withdrawal labels are shown as context.

See [the coverage table](docs/COVERAGE.md) before relying on a particular check.

### Start menu and follow-up

Running the tool in a terminal without choosing a check shows a menu. Enter starts the
standard check; 0 quits without scanning. The same menu offers a full check, a
browsers-only check, selected files or folders, or a phone collection. Scripts with
non-interactive input do not see it; `--no-menu` turns menus off.

The browsers entry also offers a test of whether your browser blocks ads. That test only
works inside a browser, so the tool asks first and then opens the ArchiveGenocide test page
in your default browser. The browser goes online for it; the tool does not. See
[PRIVACY.md](PRIVACY.md).

After a menu-selected check you can inspect findings and references, review gaps and next
steps, save reports, or prepare a private evidence bundle. `--post-menu` offers the same
after a command-line scan. The report is shown before those choices. The Windows launcher
keeps prompts visible and saves both readable and JSON reports.

`--report PATH` saves the readable report, independently of `--json` and `--share-json`.
Reports never replace an existing file inside a selected evidence folder, a selected input
file, or the app data and app cache folders where desktop apps keep the records the scan
reads. Choose a new filename. No baseline snapshots are kept.

### Private evidence handoff

`--evidence-bundle PATH` creates a new, **unencrypted** private ZIP with the full JSON
report, readable report, minimal sharing summary and an integrity manifest. Repeat
`--evidence-file PATH` to add original local files you choose. Report text never chooses
files to copy, and nothing is uploaded or sent to a helpline.

```text
python scan/zero-breach-toolkit.py --scan-type targeted --target SUSPICIOUS_FILE --report report.txt --json report.json --evidence-bundle evidence.zip --evidence-file SUSPICIOUS_FILE
```

`SUSPICIOUS_FILE` is the path of one file; `--evidence-file` takes files, not folders.

The archive is previewed before it is created, never overwrites an existing file, and is
limited to 128 originals of up to 64 MiB each and 256 MiB in total. It records SHA-256
hashes, tool version, scope, times and fingerprints of the indicator sets used. Hashes show
later integrity, not authenticity to the original device. Originals are copied at export
time and may differ from what was scanned; live databases may need their sidecar files
selected too. Use the minimal summary for first contact, and share the full archive only
through a secure route agreed with the recipient.

---

## Reading the result

The report starts with a short summary: what was found, what it means, what to do, and what
could not be checked. The evidence follows.

- **Findings** carry an evidence grade. "A known spyware file is on this machine" or "an
  app researchers name is on this phone" is strong. "A saved web page mentions the address"
  is weak, and is usually an article about the spyware. The grade, not the number of
  matches, decides what to do.
- **Worth a look** lists things the tool cannot judge on its own (a sideloaded app, a
  command that downloaded code, an antivirus exclusion), each with its usual harmless
  explanation. They are not findings.
- **In time order** lists every dated finding and item.
- **What could not be checked.** Read this part. A check that could not run has not
  cleared anything.

Exit codes for scripts:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `0` | no actionable matches and no recorded coverage gaps |
| `1` | setup, argument or output error |
| `2` | a match beyond a saved reference |
| `3` | no actionable matches, but checks or indicator sources were incomplete |
| `4` | the start menu was closed without scanning (no verdict or report) |

Reference-only matches stay visible and return `0` or `3`, depending on gaps. No exit code
proves a device is safe.

## What it cannot do

- It only finds published indicators. New or unpublished spyware will not be found.
- Spyware is often rebuilt for each target, and many traces expire within weeks.
- An Android check sees only what the collection contains; an iPhone check sees only
  supported artifacts in the local evidence supplied. Neither is a full phone examination.
- It does not replace a forensic examination by experts. If you are worried, ask for help.

## Privacy

`--update` downloads indicator sources. The separate `--collect-android` command downloads
a pinned official collector after consent. Ordinary scans stay offline. Full reports can
contain usernames, profile names, file paths, browsing details, SMS senders and message
excerpts; keep them private. `--share-json summary.json` writes counts, scope labels, the
verdict and fixed advice, and leaves out artifact text, indicator values and dates. It is an
initial summary, not forensic evidence; review it before sharing. See [PRIVACY.md](PRIVACY.md).

## For scripts and assistants

`--describe` prints, as JSON, every check the tool runs, what each reads and cannot see,
the exit codes and the rules for relaying a result. `--json` writes a machine-readable
report that marks the fields to relay to the person, the next steps that may be given, and
which fields hold untrusted text from the scanned machine. See
[scan/CONTRACT.md](scan/CONTRACT.md).

A [skill file](skills/zero-breach-toolkit/SKILL.md) is included for assistants that support
skills: add the `skills/zero-breach-toolkit` folder to the assistant's skill directory, or
have it read that file. It covers scope selection, encrypted-backup prompts, offline
operation, report interpretation and evidence privacy. Nothing is installed automatically.

## Tested platforms

Windows, macOS, Linux, Android (AndroidQF collections) and iPhone (local backups). See
[docs/COVERAGE.md](docs/COVERAGE.md) for what each check reads and its limits. Built-in
readers share one registry for platform selection, coverage descriptions and the
single-file build; see [scan/READERS.md](scan/READERS.md) to add one.

## Where the code is

There is no `src` folder; the code is under [`scan/`](scan/):

- [`scan/zero-breach-toolkit.py`](scan/zero-breach-toolkit.py): the entry point you run.
- [`scan/zbtriage/`](scan/zbtriage/): the scanner (indicator loading, the network block,
  reporting). The package keeps the project's earlier name so existing installs keep working.
- [`scan/zbtriage/modules/`](scan/zbtriage/modules/): one file per check (browsers, Windows
  records, macOS and Linux, Android, iPhone, file fingerprints).
- [`scan/tests/`](scan/tests/): the test suite.
- [`build/bundle.py`](build/bundle.py): builds the single file attached to each release from
  this source (see [Verify what you run](#verify-what-you-run)).

## Credits

Indicators are the work of Amnesty International's Security Lab, the Citizen Lab, the MVT
project and Echap.

## Licence

Code, including the generated scanner: Apache License 2.0 ([LICENSE](LICENSE)). The curated
indicator files in `iocs/` and generated indicator exports in `dist/`: CC0 1.0, public
domain ([iocs/LICENSE.md](iocs/LICENSE.md)). Optional bundled research rules keep their own
licences in [third_party/candiru](third_party/candiru/README.md). Indicator lists downloaded
by `--update` remain under their publishers' terms and are not part of this repository.

# 词光 · Word Atlas **一词一画，点亮雅思。** 7,298 个雅思核心词，每个词一幅原创插画、两条原创例句、英美发音和一套刚刚好的复习节奏。
免费，开源，无需注册，打开网页就能背。 [**打开词光 →**](https://0xlei.tech/words/)  ·  [▶ 看宣传片](docs/assets/launch.mp4)  ·  [下载词库](data/)  ·  [English](README.en.md) ![MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/code-MIT-1E2640) ![CC BY 4.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/content-CC%20BY%204.0-C4573A) ![words](https://img.shields.io/badge/words-7%2C298-7F9B77) ![FSRS](https://img.shields.io/badge/scheduler-FSRS%206-D9A03A) ![no login](https://img.shields.io/badge/login-not%20required-6F93AE) ![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/designfuchen/word-atlas?style=flat&color=E8B65A) 每本单词书都从 abandon 开始，也停在 abandon。▶ 点击画面看 48 秒完整宣传片（有声音）
--- ## 为什么做词光 背单词最难的不是“看过”，而是“想得起来”。 纸质单词书把 7,000 个词排成一张清单，大多数人翻到第一页就停下了。词光换了个做法：给每个词一幅画，让你先**看见**它；用主动回忆让你**想起**它；再用 FSRS 算法在你快要忘记的时候让你和它**重逢**。你学会的每一个词，都会在自己的词汇星图上点亮一颗星。 这是一个个人项目。所有释义、例句、插画和录音都是为这个项目新做的，制作成本由作者自己承担，然后全部开源，任何人都可以免费使用、修改和再分发。 ## 一眼看懂 | 数量 | 内容 | |---:|---| | **7,298** | 雅思核心词条，CEFR A1–C2 分级，19 个雅思高频话题 | | **7,298** | 幅原创插画，统一的复古图鉴画风，画的就是例句里的场景 | | **14,596** | 条原创例句：一条日常短句帮你记住，一条雅思语境长句帮你会用 | | **22,905** | 段录音：英音、美音单词发音，以及例句朗读 | | **0** | 账号、广告、追踪。进度只保存在你自己的设备上 | ## 看一看，听一听 7,298 幅插画、22,905 段录音、24 段界面声音，都是为词光专门做的。下面是一小部分。 ### 🖼 每个词一幅画 画面讲的就是例句里的那件事，同一种复古图鉴画风贯穿全部 7,298 个词。

abandon 遗弃；抛弃
We had to abandon our car in the snow.
volcano 火山
We watched steam rising from the volcano across the lake.
orchestra 管弦乐队
The orchestra began playing as the lights dimmed.
telescope 望远镜
We watched the moon through a telescope on the balcony.

migrate 迁徙；移居
These birds migrate south when the weather turns cold.
festival 节日；庆祝活动
Our town holds a lantern festival every autumn.
lighthouse 灯塔
The lighthouse beam swept across the dark sea.
astronaut 宇航员；航天员
The astronaut floated gently through the small space station.
### 🔊 每个词都会读 拿 *abandon* 举例，点开就能听（在线播放）： | | | |---|---| | 🇬🇧 英音 | [abandon /əˈbændən/](https://0xlei.tech/words/atlas/audio/uk/abandon.mp3) | | 🇺🇸 美音 | [abandon /əˈbændən/](https://0xlei.tech/words/atlas/audio/us/abandon.mp3) | | 📖 例句朗读 | [We had to abandon our car in the snow.](https://0xlei.tech/words/atlas/audio/ex/abandon.mp3) | 全部 7,298 个词都有英音、美音和例句朗读，还有 1,011 个重点词的第二条例句也配了朗读。 ### 🎧 整个应用都有声音 | | | |---|---| | 🎙 **开屏配音** | [「欢迎打开雅思大门」](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/splash-voice.mp3)：星尘汇聚成“词光”，大门打开 | | 🌌 **星图配音** | [「这是你的词汇星图。每学会一个词，就点亮一颗星。」](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/voice-galaxy-hello.mp3) | | 🎵 **星空音乐** | [一段可无缝循环的原创配乐](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/amb-stars.mp3)，默认陪你背词 | | 🌧 **6 段环境声** | [雨天图书馆](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/amb-rain.mp3) · [清晨海岸](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/amb-sea.mp3) · [林间早晨](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/amb-forest.mp3) · [夜晚壁炉](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/amb-fire.mp3) · [远航船舱](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/amb-voyage.mp3) · [安静咖啡馆](https://0xlei.tech/words/sfx/amb-cafe.mp3) | | ✨ **界面音效** | 答对、答错、翻卡、打字、连胜、点亮星星……每个操作都有自己的声音；读单词时背景音会自动压低 | 全部素材都在仓库里：插画在 `public/atlas/img/`，录音在 `public/atlas/audio/`，这两类按 CC BY 4.0 开放；界面声音和配乐在 `public/sfx/`，随应用一起提供。 ## 每个词都有什么 | | | |---|---| | 🖼 **一幅插画** | 画面讲的就是第一条例句里的事。抽象词也用具体场景表达，比如 *abandon* 是雪地里被丢下的车。 | | 🔊 **英美发音** | 英音、美音分别合成，例句也会读（AI 语音，ElevenLabs）。 | | ✍️ **两条原创例句** | 日常句 + 雅思语境句（教育、环境、科技、城市……），都配自然的中文翻译。 | | 📚 **中英释义** | 最多 3 个常用义项，按雅思使用频率排序，附简明英文解释。 | | 🧩 **搭配、词族、近反义** | 高频搭配带中文，词族之间可以互相跳转。 | | 💡 **一条提示** | 易混词、用法陷阱或记忆方法，不编造词源。 | ## 词汇星图 7,298 个词就是 7,298 颗星。19 个话题各成一条旋臂，简单的词在中心，难的在外缘。没学的是星尘，学习中的会发光，掌握了的燃成白色，今天新点亮的是金色。拖动旋转、滚动缩放，点任意一颗星就能打开它的词卡。 星图用 WebGL2 自定义着色器渲染，不支持的设备会自动降级。 ## 怎么帮你记住 - **主动回忆**：看义选词、看图补句、听音辨词、拼写，四种题型从“认得”走到“会写”。 - **FSRS 间隔复习**：和新版 Anki 同款的开源记忆算法，只在你快要遗忘时安排复习，目标记忆率可调。 - **诚实的统计**：只有第一次作答计分。答错的词会换个题型再练，但重试不会抬高正确率。 - **从你的水平开始**：选 A2 / B1 / B2 / C1 起点，跳过已经熟悉的词。 - **打字工作室**：单词、例句抄写、整句听写三种模式，WPM 和准确率单独统计，不影响记忆数据。 - **声音设计**：每个操作都有温和的木琴、纸张和铃声音效；一段星空音乐和 6 段环境声（雨天图书馆、清晨海岸、夜晚壁炉……）陪你专注，读单词时自动压低。 - **开屏仪式**：星尘汇聚成“词光”，大门打开，“欢迎打开雅思大门”。每天一次，可以关掉。 - **离线可用**：看过的词、插画和音频都缓存在本地，没网也能复习。 - **分享卡片**：任何一个词、每天的学习成果，都能一键生成图片。 - **备份恢复**：进度可以导出成文件，换设备时导入即可。
## 一份可以自由使用的词库 `data/` 里是完整词库，内容采用 **CC BY 4.0**：注明出处即可自由使用、修改、商用。 | 文件 | 内容 | |---|---| | [`data/word-atlas.json`](data/word-atlas.json) | 完整结构化数据 | | [`data/word-atlas.csv`](data/word-atlas.csv) | 表格版，可直接导入 Excel / Anki | | `public/atlas/img/` | 7,298 幅 512 px WebP 插画（另有 256 px 缩略图） | | `public/atlas/audio/` | `uk/` `us/` 单词发音，`ex/` `ex2/` 例句朗读，MP3 | ```json { "id": "principle", "w": "principle", "uk": "/ˈprɪnsəpəl/", "us": "/ˈprɪnsəpəl/", "senses": [{ "pos": "n.", "zh": "原则；行为准则", "en": "A belief or rule that guides decisions and behaviour." }], "ex": [ { "en": "I refused the extra money as a matter of principle.", "zh": "出于原则，我拒绝了那笔额外的钱。" }, { "en": "The principle of equal opportunity should guide policies designed to improve access to higher education.", "zh": "…" } ], "col": ["in principle｜原则上", "basic principle｜基本原则"], "fam": ["principled (adj.)"], "tip": "principle 是原则；principal 是校长、主要的。", "cefr": "B2", "topic": "thinking" } ``` 三行代码就能用起来： ```python import json words = json.load(open("data/word-atlas.json", encoding="utf-8")) b2_env = [w for w in words if w["cefr"] == "B2" and w["topic"] == "environment"] ``` 可以拿它做 Anki 牌组、背词小程序、浏览器插件、AI 应用的评测集，或者你自己的研究。字段说明见 [docs/dataset.md](docs/dataset.md)。 ## 本地运行 需要 Node.js 20+。 ```bash git clone https://github.com/designfuchen/word-atlas.git cd word-atlas npm ci npm run dev ``` 打开 `http://localhost:5188`。同一 Wi-Fi 下的手机可以访问终端里显示的 Network 地址。 ```bash npm test # 单元测试 npm run check:atlas # 校验词库结构与媒体文件 npm run build # 生产构建，输出到 dist/ ``` 部署就是把 `dist/` 放到任意静态托管。子路径部署用 `ATLAS_BASE=/words/ npm run build`，见 [docs/deployment.md](docs/deployment.md)。 ## 内容是怎么做出来的 词表来自常见的雅思阅读核心词，去重后 7,298 个词条。词条内容全部是本项目新写的： 1. **文字**：大语言模型按统一的词典编写规范，逐词生成释义、例句、搭配和提示，再做结构和一致性校验。 2. **插画**：图像模型按统一画风逐词绘制，画面对应第一条例句。 3. **声音**：英音、美音和例句朗读由 ElevenLabs 合成；界面音效和环境声同样为本项目生成。 生成脚本在 [`scripts/atlas/`](scripts/atlas)，完整流程见 [docs/pipeline.md](docs/pipeline.md)，记忆模型见 [docs/learning-model.md](docs/learning-model.md)。 > **诚实说明**：内容经过了结构、引用和一致性的自动校验，但没有逐条人工审校，可能有个别不准确的释义、例句或插画。发现问题欢迎提 Issue，或者直接修改 `data/` 提 PR。这不是官方雅思词表，也不承诺提分。 ## 参与贡献 - **纠错**：在 Issue 里写清楚词条 id 和问题，或者直接提 PR。每一处纠错都会让下一个人背得更准。 - **新功能**：先开 Issue 讨论，保持“无账号、本地优先、安静好看”的方向。 - **代码**：TypeScript 严格模式，`npm test` 和 `npm run check:atlas` 需要通过。 详见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)。 ## 授权 - 代码：[MIT](LICENSE) - 词库文本、插画、录音：[CC BY 4.0](CONTENT_LICENSE.md)，署名 “Word Atlas contributors（词光）” - 字体 Fraunces：SIL Open Font License；记忆算法 [ts-fsrs](https://github.com/open-spaced-repetition/ts-fsrs)：MIT ## Star 趋势 [![Star History Chart](https://api.star-history.com/svg?repos=designfuchen/word-atlas&type=Date)](https://star-history.com/#designfuchen/word-atlas&Date)

items.description: dsh-go — DeepSeek Harness 装进口袋：手机本机运行，也能遥控你的电脑。
items.readme:
简体中文 · English

DeepSeek Harness 的 Android 客户端。手机上直接跑，也能遥控你电脑上的 DSH。


Deepy 和鲸娘，陪你干活

干活时敲代码，做完来个空翻，等你确认会举手。打开「App 外显示」，它们还会跟你到桌面。


下载 DSH Go

从 GitHub Releases 或官网下载页获取最新版 APK，常见手机选 arm64 包。

 

感谢大家对 DSH Go 的支持和喜爱，我将尽快适配 iOS 和鸿蒙！大家 Star 点得越多，我适配得越快哦 hhh

第一次用可以先看使用指南，遇到问题欢迎来论坛和 QQ 群。
手机上装过签名不同的早期测试包时不能直接覆盖安装，需要先卸载旧版；卸载会清空对话、Linux 环境和设置。


本机运行，也能遥控电脑

内置 Linux 环境，免 Root、免 Termux。电脑上的 DSH，也能一键切过去接着用。


插话、打断，过程自动收好

回复中途也能插话，排队的消息随时「立即发送」。做完的过程折叠成一行。


原生界面，也有网页版

和官方网页版一键切换，停在同一段对话，下次打开还是你上次用的那个。


分享卡、对话回放和链接

回复一键做成分享卡。整段对话生成链接，对方在浏览器里回放，链接端到端加密。


横屏与平板

横屏手机和平板重新排版：侧栏常驻，内容居中，弹出键盘也不挤。


主题配色与桌面图标

六套主题色，也能跟随壁纸或自选颜色。四款桌面图标，三种功能图标风格。


中文，也说 English

全部界面支持英文，在设置里切换，默认跟随系统。


手机操控

看屏幕、帮你点，三档确认随你选。付款、密码和验证码，永远交还给你。


## 可以做什么 DSH Go 提供聊天界面、本机运行环境和远程连接，是基于 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的第三方项目。运行在手机上的是 DSH 引擎；模型请求仍由你配置的模型提供方处理。 - **本机运行**：在 App 内安装 Ubuntu、Node.js 与 DSH 运行环境，无需 Root 或另装 Termux。 - **远程连接**：通过 SSH 或 DSH Remote 使用电脑、服务器上的 DSH。 - **聊天与工具**：切换模型，发送图片、使用语音输入，处理工具审批和提问；支持聊天界面与网页模式。 - **插件界面**：使用适配 DSH Go 的原生工具卡、表单和面板；仓库提供 SDK、教程和示例。 - **手机操控**：在你开启权限后，让本机引擎读取屏幕、点按和输入，并可随时停止。 - **分享与外观**：分享、导出和回放对话，调整主题、图标和桌宠。 功能随主机和连接方式不同。DSH Remote 当前只支持图片附件，不能在 App 内打开网页版，插件管理限于开关，且不支持 DS Bot 和对话日志导出。详见[本机引擎与远程主机](docs/guide/zh/03-engine-hosts.md)。 ## 安装 安装要求为 Android 8.0（API 26）及以上。Release 页面上的 **arm64** 安装包适用于常见的 64 位 Android 手机；x86_64 设备和模拟器用的 x64 包在发布说明末尾的「其他版本下载」里。仓库没有 32 位 ARM 构建。 1. 从 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go/releases/latest) 或[官网下载页](https://go.dshtui.com/download)下载对应架构的 APK，并按系统提示允许该安装来源。 2. 首次启动时，选择在本机安装运行环境，或连接远程主机。 3. 为所选主机配置模型和所需凭据，再开始对话；部分远程渠道需要在主机侧配置。 仅连接远程主机时，不必在手机上安装本机运行环境。手机操控只对正常模式下的本机引擎开放，需要按界面说明开启无障碍等权限；不打扰模式另外要求 Android 14 及以上，以及 Shizuku 或自连 ADB。首次使用可按[使用指南](docs/guide/README.md)逐项配置。 本地引擎默认使用 PRoot 兼容启动。开发者选项中的直接启动默认关闭，开启后的兼容性和回退方式见[常见问题](docs/guide/zh/11-faq.md)。当前 Android 构建以 APK 侧载为目标，不是 Google Play 发布配置。 ## 数据与权限 模型请求会发送给你配置的提供方。开启手机操控后，任务需要的屏幕文字可能发送给模型，支持看图的模型也可能收到截图；请先阅读 App 的权限说明。 “发送匿名使用统计”默认开启，可在首次引导或“设置 → 隐私与分享”关闭。采集范围和关闭后的处理见[常见问题](docs/guide/zh/11-faq.md)。分享内容前，请检查预览；收到链接或文件的人可以保存其中的内容。 ## 常见问题
和 DeepSeek 官方是什么关系？
没有关系。DSH Go 是社区开发的非官方客户端，基于开源的 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 构建。手机上运行的是 DSH 本身；模型请求发给你配置的模型提供方，需要联网，按你在提供方的账户计费。
安全吗？
本机网页版只接受 App 自己的访问。分享链接端到端加密，密钥只在链接里，服务器看不到内容。手机操控遇到付款、密码、验证码和系统设置，一律交还给你。
切到后台会被杀吗？
部分系统的省电策略会拦住后台。DSH Go 发现后会提醒你，并直达对应的放行设置，vivo、小米、华为、荣耀、OPPO 都有。
对手机有什么要求？
Android 8 及以上。手机直接下载 Release 页面上的安装包即可，模拟器用的 x86_64 版在发布说明末尾的「其他版本下载」里。在手机上运行 DSH 要先准备内置的运行环境，请预留约 1 GB 空间；只连电脑或服务器上的 DSH 可以不装。
开源吗？
开源，代码就在这个仓库，以 [AGPL-3.0](LICENSE) 发布，`sdk/` 和 `examples/` 为 MIT。DSH Go 的名称和标识，以及 Deepy、鲸娘两位吉祥物，不在开源授权范围内，见 [ASSETS.md](ASSETS.md)。
## 从源码构建 以下流程面向 **Linux x86_64**。当前工具链脚本默认安装 JDK 17、Flutter 3.47.7 和 Android SDK/NDK；App 要求 Dart `^3.13.5`。准备 Bash、Git、curl、tar、unzip、xz、Python 3、zstd（Python 未提供 `compression.zstd` 时用于解包 zstd 压缩的 deb）、file 和常见 GNU 命令；重新解析 Ubuntu 软件包锁时还需要 gpgv。 先取得完整源码和项目资源。`app/pubspec.yaml` 声明的字体、图片等都是构建输入，运行时包由下面的脚本生成。 ```bash git clone https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go.git cd dsh-go bash tooling/setup-toolchain.sh source tooling/env.sh flutter --version java -version bash runtime/build-runtime.sh arm64-v8a DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE= bash tooling/build-apk.sh -f arm64 --keep-daemon ``` 工具链脚本会下载 SDK/NDK 与模拟器镜像，并执行 Android SDK 许可接受步骤。默认安装到 `~/dev`；可通过 `DEV_ROOT` 指定独立目录。脚本会复用已有安装，构建前请核对版本。 产物为 `app/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-arm64-release.apk`。运行时构建使用仓库固定的版本与校验信息，并需要联网下载依赖。示例中的 `DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE=` 不嵌入维护者的内测通道令牌；`--keep-daemon` 保留 Gradle daemon，适合同时开发其他 Android 项目的环境。 构建 x86_64 包时，先生成对应运行时： ```bash bash runtime/build-runtime.sh x86_64 DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE= bash tooling/build-apk.sh -f x64 --keep-daemon ``` 未配置 `app/android/key.properties` 时，本地 release 构建使用 debug 签名。它不能直接覆盖不同签名的官方安装包；请在测试设备上安装，保留已有数据，不要为解决签名冲突直接卸载正在使用的 App。发布签名与密钥文件不要提交到仓库。 只查看 APK 构建命令，可运行： ```bash DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE= bash tooling/build-apk.sh --dry-run -f all ``` ## 目录 | 路径 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | `app/` | Flutter 界面与 Android Kotlin 平台实现 | | `packages/dsh_client/` | DSH Web API 的 Dart 客户端 | | `packages/dsh_remote/` | DSH Remote 的 Dart 客户端 | | `runtime/` | Linux 运行时打包、引擎补丁与 App 桥接 | | `sdk/plugin-kit/` | 原生插件作者工具包；在仓库中使用，未发布到 npm | | `examples/plugins/` | 插件示例 | | `docs/guide/`、`docs/plugins/` | 用户指南与插件开发文档 | | `docs/assets/` | 本页用到的展示图、桌宠动图和社群二维码 | | `tooling/` | 工具链、APK 构建与诊断脚本 | | `services/`、`site/`、`infra/` | 配套分享服务、网站和部署材料 | ## 参与贡献 问题反馈和改进建议可提交到 [Issues](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go/issues)。代码、文档和翻译贡献请先看 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)。插件作者可以从[插件教程](docs/plugins/README.md)和 [SDK](sdk/plugin-kit/README.md)开始。 安全问题请按 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) 报告，避免在公开 Issue 中提交漏洞细节或凭据。 ## 社区 - items.description: A Claude skill that turns vibecoded, AI-looking UI into a designed interface
items.readme:
# unslop

Created by Damir Sokolovsky ([@heydamir](https://x.com/heydamir)), who started the [Unslopping series](https://x.com/heydamir/status/2115063463063998736) on X.

![A vibecoded dashboard unslopping itself, frame by frame](skills/unslop/references/refs/story-dashboard-frames.webp)

unslop is a skill for Claude that turns vibecoded, AI-looking UI into a designed interface with its own character. It finds the slop first, the purple gradients, glows, emoji labels, shouty copy and uneven spacing, then sets a direction from your product and fixes the screen pass by pass like a designer doing a redline review. It works in whatever your screen is built with, like Next.js, React, Vue, Svelte, Tailwind or plain HTML and CSS, on dashboards, apps and landing pages, and even on a live site when all you have is a link.

## Install

For Claude Code, copy the skill into your skills folder.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/heydamir/unslop
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r unslop/skills/unslop ~/.claude/skills/
```

For a single project, copy it into `.claude/skills/` inside that project instead.

## Use

In Claude Code, type `/unslop` with what you want, or just ask in your own words and Claude picks the skill up by itself.

```
/unslop this dashboard
/unslop the hero of https://example.com
/unslop my landing page and make the story video so I can post it
```

It audits the screen and proposes a direction before it edits anything, so you can steer it early. If the screen is already good, it tells you so and suggests a few small refinements instead of redesigning it.

## What it does

- **Audit.** Lists every sign of slop with where it lives.
- **Direction.** Character, world, the one or two moments that carry the color, and a signature detail, all taken from your product.
- **Passes.** Spacing, color, icons, copy, type, layout, details, visuals and motion, in that order.
- **Visuals.** Shows your product instead of a glossy blob. When a hero needs a scene or an object, it can generate one through an image service like fal, Replicate, OpenAI images or Higgsfield. If none is connected, it offers to connect one as an MCP server, and it shows the prompt and asks before every paid generation. Dashboards and apps rarely need one.
- **Story video.** A square video under 10 seconds of your screen unslopping itself, ready to post. It needs Playwright and ffmpeg.

Try it on the two vibecoded screens in [examples](examples).

## Hire the unslopper

Would rather have a designer do it? Damir unslops one key screen in 3 days, built in your stack, at [heydamir.design/unslop](https://heydamir.design/unslop).

Mika

简体中文 · [English](README.en.md) **你手机上的私人 AI 助理，替你操作 App、上网、把事办成。**
它在一块看不见的后台屏上干活，你照样刷你的手机。

⬇ 下载 Mika（安卓 APK）

[安装](#安装) · [快速开始](#快速开始) · [能做什么](#能做什么) · [常见问题](#常见问题) · [参与贡献](#参与贡献)
## 安装 **方式一：在手机上自己装** 1. 从 [Releases](https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika/releases/latest) 下载最新的 APK，安装。 2. 打开 Mika 设置里的「设置手机操作」向导，配对一次无线调试（[设置指南](docs/setup-guide.md)）。 3. 在设置里的「模型」添加服务商、填 API Key，或者用 ChatGPT、xAI、OpenRouter 账号登录。 每一步的细节见下文的[快速开始](#快速开始)。 **方式二：让电脑上的 AI 助手帮你装** 手机用数据线连上电脑，在手机上打开 USB 调试（开发者选项里别的开关不要动，除非 AI 助手请你打开；有的会清除手机数据），然后把下面这句话发给电脑上能执行命令的 AI 助手： ``` 请按 https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika/blob/main/docs/install-with-agent.md 的步骤，帮我把 Mika 安装到通过 USB 连着的安卓手机上。 ``` 它会检查手机、下载安装、打开需要的权限，需要你在手机上点的时候会停下来告诉你。API Key 由你自己在 Mika 里填，不经过它。 **装好之后：让电脑上的 AI 工具直接用 Mika（MCP）** 手机用数据线连着电脑，在电脑上运行： ``` adb shell sh /sdcard/Android/data/com.wangzan101.mika/files/connect-computer.sh adb forward tcp:8765 tcp:8765 ``` 第一条会打开 Mika 的电脑连接，并打印连接信息（地址 `http://127.0.0.1:8765/mcp` 和令牌）；把它们填进电脑上 AI 工具的 MCP 配置，它就能给 Mika 派任务、查进度、拿结果。手机上不用点；只经数据线连接、要令牌，Wi-Fi 上连不到；付款这类确认只能在手机上点。用方式二安装时，AI 助手会顺手帮你接好。详见[电脑连接说明](docs/mcp.md)。 > **English summary** > > Mika is an Android app that takes a one-sentence request and carries it out on your phone. It drives apps on a private background screen (so you can keep using your phone), browses the web in a built-in desktop-class browser, and runs scripts in a local Linux sandbox. You bring your own model API key (several providers are supported as presets, plus any OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic, Gemini or OpenAI Responses endpoint). There is no Mika server: your requests go only to the model provider you configure. > > Status: **public beta**, changing quickly (see [Releases](https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika/releases) for versions and changes). Chat, web and sandbox tasks work on Android 11+; phone app control needs Android 12+, with Android 14+ recommended. The sandbox runs on arm64 devices only. The app UI is available in Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and English (follows your system language; switch in Settings › Language); see the [full English README](README.en.md). Licensed under Apache-2.0. ## Beta 说明 - 这是早期公开测试版，功能和界面还在快速变化，升级时可能有不兼容的改动。 - 目前主要在一台安卓 14 手机上测试过。别的安卓版本、别的手机上可能遇到没见过的问题，欢迎[反馈](#参与贡献)。 - Mika 会替你操作第三方 App 和网站，请先读[免责声明](#免责声明)。 ## 演示


后台发微信：左边是 Mika 的对话页，右边是 Mika 在后台屏上的每一步
（加速 4 倍；聊天列表已打码）


后台翻完微信群，总结今天聊了啥
（加速播放；总结正文涉及群友发言，已打码）
打开小红书，总结一位博主的内容
（加速播放）
在 BOSS 直聘网页上给 3 个岗位打招呼
（加速播放）

打开 Hacker News，读出首页前 5 条和分数
（加速 1.5 倍）
在 Google Flights 上找旧金山到纽约最便宜的直飞
（加速 3 倍；价格按网络所在地区显示为港币）
在 Amazon 上找 30 美元以内、4.5 星以上的 USB-C 充电器，加进购物车，停在结账前
（加速 3.5 倍）

在 BOSS 直聘网页上找岗位、打招呼
打开汽水音乐，看广告领听歌权益
在美团上凑满减、点外卖，付款前问你
## 能做什么 你用一句话交代一件事，Mika 在手机上替你办。 ### 操作任何 App，不占你的屏幕 手机上装的 App 都能操作，不用事先适配：Mika 像人一样看屏幕、找按钮、点击输入，看得到就能操作。 - 在一块单独的后台屏上打开 App、读界面、点击、输入、滚动，你照常用手机；对话页上的小画面实时显示它在做什么。 - 能逐屏读长列表和聊天记录，比如「帮我总结一下某个群今天都聊了些啥」。 - 界面读不出来的 App（自己画界面、控件没有名字）也能用：Mika 用随 APK 自带的文字识别读屏上的字；配了能看图的模型时，还能看图找按钮和输入框。 - 能把一段文字直接分享进某个 App（发消息、记笔记），收件人和发送仍由 Mika 在那一页上点。 - 系统问「用哪个 App 打开」、装了两份的 App 问「打开哪一个」、一个 App 打开另一个 App（比如跳到付款页）时，Mika 认得出来：能处理的接着做，要你选或要你亲手处理的，会停下来请你在屏幕上操作。 - 需要你亲手处理的事（登录、验证码、付款）会发通知请你接管：App 挪到主屏，你处理完交还，Mika 重新核实再继续。 ### 内置浏览器 - 任何网站都能打开：在后台打开网页，用真实的点击和键盘输入操作页面，默认按电脑版网页打开。 - 能读页面正文，也能读页面自己收到的数据；支持下载、上传。 - 登录过的网站保持登录；侧栏「浏览器」里可以自己浏览，在这里登录的网站 Mika 办事时也能直接用。 - 翻页有节奏：同一个网站连着换页会停一停，对限制浏览快慢的网站停得更久；认得出风控拦截页，交给你处理而不是硬闯。 ### 此刻的屏幕 - 你在别的 App 里时，屏幕边上有一颗 Mika 悬浮胶囊，显示后台任务的进展、要你处理的事和结果，点开可以插话、回答、同意或停止。 - **双击胶囊**，把你正在看的这一屏发给 Mika，比如「这个怎么回」「帮我记下来」；也可以在卡片里截屏、补一句话再发。 ### 定时与条件任务 - 「明早 9 点提醒我」「每天早上看看天气，下雨才告诉我」「每周五做某件事」。 - 到点在原对话里执行，结果送回来；定时任务页可以暂停、改时间、立即执行、删除。 ### 随时插话、随时停 - 任务进行中可以继续说话，补充或更正要求，Mika 在下一步之前读到。 - 按停止后，Mika 会补几行交代：做了什么、看到了什么、发出了几次、哪些没做完。下次说「继续」它知道从哪接着做。 ### 询问 / 自主 - 默认是**询问**：只有花钱（下单、付款）先问你，发消息、提交、删除这些都直接做完。也可以换成**自主**，连付款也不先问。详见[下文](#询问--自主模式)。 ### 记忆 - 记住你明确说过的事实、偏好和做事方式（做事方式要你批准），可以查看、修改、删除；只从你自己说的话里记，密码、验证码、卡号这类不记。记忆加密保存在手机上。 ### 熟悉的 App 和网站，做得更快更稳 没有任何说明，Mika 也能看着屏幕把事办成。有些 App 和网站另外写了使用知识（入口在哪、常见做法、要注意什么），Mika 用到时自动查阅，少走弯路。比如进了聊天 App 直接知道怎么找联系人、翻聊天记录；打开招聘网站知道怎么筛岗位、打招呼。另有几类事情的通用做法。知识持续增加，人人可以补充：它们是放在 [`core/src/main/resources/knowledge/`](core/src/main/resources/knowledge/) 和 [`core/src/main/resources/skills/`](core/src/main/resources/skills/) 下的纯文本文件，[欢迎补充](#参与贡献)。 已经写了使用知识的（没写到的 App 和网站照样能用）： | 类别 | 内置 | |---|---| | **App** | Android 设置、百家号、哔哩哔哩、BOSS直聘、Chrome、得到、抖音、飞书、Gmail、即刻、快手、领英、QQ邮箱、Telegram、今日头条、Uber、Uber Eats、微信、微博、WhatsApp、闲鱼、小红书、知乎 | | **网站** | Amazon、哔哩哔哩、Google Calendar、豆瓣、抖音、Instagram、Gmail、Google Maps、Telegram、百度贴吧、微博、搜狗微信、WhatsApp、小红书、小宇宙、YouTube、知乎、BOSS直聘 | | **通用做法**（技能） | 把内容整理成文字、处理 PDF 文档、查清一件事、消息与邮件 | ### 成批的事 - 成批做事（比如逐个打招呼、投递）直接开始，不用先跟你确认名单；每两次之间隔开一段随机时间，做到网站自己说「到上限了」就停下告诉你。 ### 过程可查 - 回答下面列出来源（读过的页面、截图）；每次任务都有可回看的过程记录。 - 每次任务一行小结：总用时、和模型来回几次、用了多少 Token、多久看到第一次反馈；设置里的「Token 用量」按天、按服务商、按模型统计。 ### Linux 沙箱 - 每个对话一个工作区，可以跑 Python、Node 和 shell 命令，处理你发来的文件，把结果存到手机的「下载/Mika」。 - 默认断网，需要时在设置里的「文件与计算环境」打开「允许脚本联网」。只支持 arm64 设备。 ### 电脑上的 AI 工具也能用（CLI / MCP） 手机连着电脑时，电脑上的 AI 工具可以通过 MCP 把任务交给 Mika，在手机上办完把结果拿回去。一条命令打开，只经数据线、要令牌；也可以在设置里打开局域网连接（默认关）。见[电脑连接说明](docs/mcp.md)。 也可以安装[电脑端 CLI 与 Agent Skill](docs/cli.md),用 `mika connect`、`mika task run`、`mika task wait` 完成连接和任务交接。CLI 与 MCP 并列接入同一份手机任务服务,CLI 不需要配置 MCP;需要包含任务 API v1 的 APK。 ## 快速开始 ### 系统要求 | 项目 | 要求 | |---|---| | 安装、聊天、网页与沙箱任务 | 安卓 11 及以上（沙箱仅支持 arm64） | | 操作手机 App | 安卓 12 及以上；安卓 12、13 上后台操作可能影响主屏焦点 | | 推荐 | 安卓 14 及以上：后台屏有自己的焦点，不影响你在主屏打字；不同对话的任务同时进行也需要它 | | Linux 沙箱 | 仅 arm64 设备；其他设备照常安装，沙箱显示「此设备不支持」 | | 模型 | 一个支持工具调用的大模型 API Key | ### 1. 下载安装 从 [Releases](https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika/releases/latest) 下载最新的 APK 安装。 ### 2. 无障碍（可以先跳过） Mika 靠无障碍读界面、做点按。不用手动去开：下一步配对成功后，Mika 会自己把它打开。从 GitHub 下载安装的 App，手动打开无障碍时常被系统拦下（提示「受限制的设置」），让 Mika 自己开能省掉这个麻烦。向导里到这一步时选「跳过」即可。 ### 3. 配对无线调试（只需一次） 打开设置里的「设置手机操作」向导，照着清单做：打开开发者选项、USB 调试、无线调试，然后用 6 位配对码配对。开发者选项里 Mika 没提到的开关不要动，有的会清除手机数据，比如「以 16KB 页面大小启动设备」。 第一次设置、卡在某一步，或者不知道配对码填在哪里：看[手机操作设置指南](docs/setup-guide.md)，每一步都写了在哪里点、怎么算成功、常见问题怎么办。 为什么要这一步：Mika 有一个内置的手机助手，要在后台屏上启动和操作 App，需要借用安卓自带的无线调试来启动它。全程在手机上完成，不需要电脑和数据线。配对过后，如果无线调试被系统关掉了（换 Wi-Fi、重启手机后安卓会关掉它），Mika 在你允许的前提下会自己把它重新打开。 手边有电脑和数据线的话，也可以不配对：先打开一次 Mika，插着线在电脑上运行 `adb shell sh /sdcard/Android/data/com.wangzan101.mika/files/usb-start.sh` 启动手机助手；但每次重启手机后都要再运行一次。这些也可以交给电脑上的 AI 助手，见[用电脑上的 AI 助手安装](docs/install-with-agent.md)。 只用上网、文件和聊天的话，这一步可以先跳过。 ### 4. 添加模型 打开设置里的「模型」（第一次打开 App 时也会引导你）。 内置 DeepSeek、通义千问、Kimi、智谱、硅基流动、火山方舟、MiniMax、阶跃星辰、腾讯混元、百度千帆、OpenRouter、OpenCode Go、Anthropic、Gemini、OpenAI、xAI、Mistral、Groq、Ollama、LM Studio 等服务商预设；其他服务商选「自定义」，OpenAI 兼容、Anthropic、Gemini、OpenAI Responses 接口都能接。 也可以不填 Key，用账号登录：添加服务商最上面是「用账号登录 · 不用填 Key」一组，点一家先看说明，再去浏览器里登录，登录后回到 Mika，能看到账号、可用的模型，可以直接设为主模型。 - **ChatGPT**（Plus 或 Pro，用你的套餐额度）：点「使用 ChatGPT 继续」，在浏览器里登录。 - **xAI / Grok**（SuperGrok 或 X Premium+ 订阅）：浏览器里打开 xAI 的确认页，核对手机上显示的短码后同意。这项登录借用 xAI 官方命令行工具的公开登录入口，不是 xAI 专门给 Mika 开的，xAI 可能限制这种用法；有的订阅档位登录后仍不能调用（提示 403），那时改用 xAI 的 API Key。 - **OpenRouter**：OpenRouter 官方给第三方应用的授权。同意后 OpenRouter 给 Mika 一把属于你的 Key（名字是 Mika），用量从你的 OpenRouter 余额里扣；不想用了，在 OpenRouter 的 Keys 页面删掉它。 退出登录只清这台手机上的登录信息。 1. 添加服务商：选一个预设，或选「自定义」填接口地址；填 API Key。Ollama、LM Studio 这类自己机器上跑的服务，地址预填了默认端口，改成那台机器的地址即可，Key 可不填。 2. 点「测试并保存」，连上第一家时会自动选一个主模型。 3. 主模型要支持工具调用。可选：看图模型（看懂界面、看图找按钮）、轻量模型（便宜快的即可，处理判断结局、提取记忆等小事）。 用 ChatGPT 登录或 Responses 接口的模型，可在各用途卡片下调整「思考强度」。默认用服务商默认值；选「用主模型」时也跟随它的强度，明确选同一个模型则可分别设置。档位优先采用服务商报告的列表；没报告时提供手动选项，实际支持情况以服务端为准。更高强度通常更慢、消耗更多 token。 ### 5. 试一试 空对话里有几条示例，点一下就能改了再发。也可以这样说： - 「帮我总结一下微信群今天都聊了些啥」 - 「打开小红书，帮我总结一下某个博主最近发的内容」 - 「帮我订明天早上 9:40、9:50、10:00 的闹钟」 - 「每天早上 8 点看看天气，下雨才告诉我」 ## 询问 / 自主模式 全局一个开关：设置里的「开发者选项」→「自主模式」，关着是询问，打开是自主。 | 模式 | 行为 | |---|---| | **询问**（默认） | 只有花钱的那一步先问你：下单、提交订单，或者页面上显示着应付金额时的确认、提交。卡片上写明在哪、买什么、多少钱，只能同意这一次或不同意。付款本身由你亲手完成。发消息、发帖、提交表单、删除、改设置这些都不问，直接做完。 | | **自主** | 连付款也不先问你，直接做完。成批做事时两次之间的间隔照样保留。 | - 换了开关管之后的所有任务；正在做的任务从询问换成自主，下一步起付款也不再问。 - 登录、验证码、付款密码这类要你亲手处理的事，两种模式都会请你接管；信息不够、或者只有你能选（比如两个同名联系人选哪个）时，也会问你。 - 定时任务等你不在场的任务，在询问模式下遇到要花钱的一步不会等人，会直接不做，并照实告诉你哪一步没做成；别的照常做完。 ## 数据与隐私 - **没有 Mika 的服务器。** 你的话、屏幕内容、截图只发给你自己配置的模型服务商。 - API Key、记忆和用户画像用安卓密钥库加密，保存在手机上。对话、运行记录、Token 用量都只存在本机。 - 检查更新只访问 GitHub。 - 内置浏览器访问的是你让它去的网站；沙箱默认断网。 ## 免责声明 - 用自动化方式操作第三方 App 和网站，可能违反它们的用户协议，有被限制功能、封号的风险。请自行判断、自担风险。 - 你同意的动作（以及自主模式下 Mika 替你做的动作）由你负责。重要的事请用询问模式，并检查结果。 - 这是 Beta 软件，按「原样」提供，不做任何担保（详见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)）。 ## 常见问题 **无线调试自己关掉了？** 安卓原版在 Wi-Fi 断开、手机重启后会关掉无线调试。设置里的「恢复与修复」中「自动打开无线调试」默认开着：需要时 Mika 会自己打开它再连接（要你允许 Mika 修改系统设置）。第一次在某个 Wi-Fi 上，系统会问是否允许，请手动打开一次并勾选「始终允许使用此网络」。如果还是连不上，回到设置里的「设置手机操作」向导重新配对即可。 **无障碍服务被关掉了？** 系统有时会停掉无障碍服务（比如进程被清理后）。「替我打开无障碍」默认开着，Mika 会自己把它重新打开；修不好时设置页会提示你手动打开。 **有的 App 页面读不到、截不到？** 有些页面（比如付款、输密码）禁止截屏，Mika 看不到画面，也不会去识别上面的字。这类页面需要你接管处理，处理好交还给 Mika。 **为什么推荐安卓 14？旧系统能用吗？** Mika 在一块单独的后台屏上操作 App，安卓 12 起可以使用手机操作能力；安卓 12、13 上操作后台屏可能影响主屏焦点。安卓 14 起后台屏有自己的焦点，不会影响你在主屏打字，所以更推荐。只用网页、沙箱和聊天，安卓 11 也能用。 **能用自己电脑或局域网里跑的模型吗？** 可以。添加服务商时选「自定义」，接口地址填 `http://` 开头的也行，比如 `http://192.168.1.10:11434/v1`（手机和那台电脑在同一个 Wi-Fi 下）。本机和局域网的地址不加提示；不加密又不在局域网里的地址会提醒一句：API Key 和对话内容可能被同一网络里的人看到，能用 `https://` 就用。 **APK 更新从哪来？** 只从本仓库的 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/wangzan101/Mika/releases) 发布。每个版本改了什么，都写在那个版本的发布说明里。 ## 参与贡献 ### 补充 App / 网站知识（不用写代码） 最简单的贡献：给某个 App 写一份 `APP.md`、给某个网站写一份 `SITE.md`，或者改进已有的。它们是带头部的 Markdown 纯文本，放在 `core/src/main/resources/knowledge/` 下。格式见 [`docs/knowledge-format.md`](docs/knowledge-format.md)。 ### 报告问题 开 Issue 时请写上：**手机型号、安卓版本、Mika 版本**（设置里的「关于 Mika」），做了什么、期望什么、实际发生了什么。能附上「查看过程」里的截图更好（注意先遮掉隐私）。 ### 贡献代码 欢迎 PR。先读 [`docs/architecture.md`](docs/architecture.md)（按代码现状写，带类名和文件路径）和 [`docs/roadmap.md`](docs/roadmap.md)（已完成、接下来、已知问题）。改动请带单元测试。 ## 开发者 ### 构建与测试 CLI 测试另需 Python 3.10+,可用 `-PmikaPython=/path/to/python3` 指定解释器。 需要 JDK 17 和 Android SDK（`local.properties` 里的 `sdk.dir`，或环境变量 `ANDROID_HOME`）。 ```bash ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug # 调试包 ./gradlew :app:assemblePerf # 看流畅度用的包：和发布版一样预先编译、不可调试，用调试签名，可直接覆盖调试包 ./gradlew :core:test :core:cliTest :app:testDebugUnitTest # 单元测试 ``` 调试包不做预先编译，界面会慢好几倍；判断流畅度请用 perf 包。 - 仓库有两个模块：`:core` 是纯 Kotlin，主循环、工具、提示词、知识都在这里，可以在电脑上用单测和假模型跑；`:app` 是安卓宿主。 - 沙箱的原生程序和自带运行环境已在仓库里；重新构建见 [`tools/sandbox/README.md`](tools/sandbox/README.md)。 - 真机评测见 [`eval/README.md`](eval/README.md)。 ### 模型配置细节 - 三个用途：**主模型**（办事，要支持工具调用）、**看图模型**（描述界面、看图定位；新装默认不用，可选「用主模型」）、**轻量模型**（判断结局、提取记忆、理解意图等小事，默认用主模型）。 - 「测试并保存」先调一次服务商公开的列模型接口，再带一个试用的工具，请会当主模型的那个模型调用它（用掉几十个 token）；都成了才保存，哪一步不成当场说原因（服务端的报错原样显示）。先试哪个：这家自己的模型在前（例如通义千问先试名字里有 qwen 的），再是列表明说能调用工具的，向量、重排、语音、画图这类不试。试的模型是它自己的问题（这个账号没开通或没权限、没有这个模型、不会调用工具）时接着试下一个，至多 3 个：通过的当主模型，并说一句先试的哪个没通过；都没通过也保存服务商（Key 是对的），不定主模型，说明原因、请你从列表里选一个开通了的，选的时候先试调用。Key、网络、地址不对照旧不保存。没列出模型时（可能这家不提供列表，也可能地址或接口类型填错了），先填一个模型名，再测试就用它试调用，通了才保存；找不到这个模型时说清是哪个、模型名大概长什么样。自定义填的是某家的官方地址时，提醒改用那家的预设（一点就换，Key 留着）。不提供列表的服务商，在选用途时手填的模型名同样先试调用；以前没试过的，服务商那一行提醒「没测试通过」，点进去可以「重新测试」。 - 模型列表上的能力标签（工具调用、看图、上下文长度）：接口给了的照实显示，没给的沿用预设初值并标「未确认」，只作参考，不拦。 - 「看图定位已验证」在设置里的「开发者选项」（调试版可见），对当前看图模型生效。 ### 文档 - [`docs/architecture.md`](docs/architecture.md)：整体结构。 - [`docs/roadmap.md`](docs/roadmap.md)：已完成、接下来、已知问题与暂缓。 - [`docs/knowledge-format.md`](docs/knowledge-format.md)：App、网站知识与技能的格式。 - [`docs/sandbox/skill-scripts.md`](docs/sandbox/skill-scripts.md)：知识与技能自带的沙箱脚本。 ### 发布与更新（维护者） - 发布在 GitHub Releases，tag 用 `vX.Y.Z`，APK 作为附件挂在这个版本上。 - 检查更新：每次打开 App 查一次 `https://api.github.com/repos/wangzan101/Mika/releases/latest`，不经别的地址。 - 关于页点「下载更新」后由系统下载服务在后台下载 APK，可查看进度、删除下载或失败后重试，重开应用仍可继续查看。下载完成后点「安装更新」，首次按提示允许 Mika 安装未知应用，再在系统安装页确认。安装前检查 APK 大小、发布附件提供的 SHA-256、包名、版本号和签名证书，系统安装器还会再验一次签名；自行编译、签名不同的版本不能直接覆盖成官方版，要先卸载。发布未包含 APK 时仍打开发布页。 ## Star 增长 ## 联系作者 - X：[@wangzan101](https://x.com/wangzan101) - 微信群：在 App 设置的「关于 Mika」›「加入交流群」扫码。 - X 群聊： ## 许可证 Mika 以 [Apache License 2.0](LICENSE) 发布，版权声明见 [NOTICE](NOTICE)。 第三方组件保留各自的许可证，见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。其中：APK 里带有 PRoot（GPL-2.0-or-later，静态链接 talloc，LGPL-3.0-or-later）编译成的独立可执行程序 `libproot.so`、`libproot_loader.so`，Mika 只以子进程方式运行它们；源码地址与校验值在 [`tools/sandbox/sources.lock`](tools/sandbox/sources.lock)，补丁在 `tools/sandbox/patches/`，可以用 `tools/sandbox/build-native.sh` 重新编译。沙箱的运行环境（Alpine Linux 3.22 的最小根文件系统和软件包）随 APK 发布，发布时附带对应源码包，做法见 [`tools/sandbox/README.md`](tools/sandbox/README.md)。

# TotK Recomp

**TotK Recomp** is a static recompilation of *The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom* (Nintendo Switch, 2023) into a native Windows x86-64 application ([docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md)).

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **No game files are included.** You need your own legally obtained copy of *Tears of the Kingdom*, dumped from your own console: the base game and the 1.2.1 or 1.4.3 update. Instructions for obtaining those files will not be provided.
>
> The game is built from your files on your machine, so the result contains the game. It is for your own use. Do not share it.

## Status

Early development. The game is playable on Windows; visual bugs and crashes are still expected.

Report problems as issues, following [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Features

- Native code, not emulation
- Game updates 1.2.1 and 1.4.3, with saves that carry over between them
- 60 fps by default; up to 144 fps or the monitor's refresh rate (experimental)
- Custom resolutions (1080p, 2k...), supersampling and AMD FSR 1 upscaling
- In-game settings menu (F1) and performance overlay (F10)
- Keyboard, mouse and gamepad with remapping, rumble and gyro
- Shaders prepared at install instead of during play

## Planned

- Linux and the Steam Deck
- Mods made for emulators: unpack a mod into a `mods` folder
- Custom aspect ratios, including ultrawide
- VRR

## Installing

Requirements: Windows 10 or later, an x86-64 CPU with AVX2, a GPU with Vulkan 1.3 and `VK_EXT_external_memory_host`, about 36 GiB free during setup (20 GiB after).

1. Download `TotK-Setup-<version>-windows.zip` from [Releases](../../releases/latest) and unpack it.
2. Start `TotK-Setup.exe`. If SmartScreen warns about an unsigned app, choose *More info*, then *Run anyway*.
3. Pick your game files, the language and an install folder, and press *Start*. The setup builds the game once.
4. Play `totk.exe` from the install folder.

To update, run a newer `TotK-Setup.exe` on the same folder; saves and settings are kept. Settings are in the in-game menu and in `totk.ini` ([totk.ini.example](totk.ini.example) lists every key). Controls: [docs/controls.md](docs/controls.md).

## Credits

TotK Recomp builds on the projects below. What was taken from each, with its license, is listed in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

- [LAS Recomp](https://github.com/peiikai/LASRecomp)
- [MacNativeGames](https://github.com/ly05010419/MacNativeGames)
- [d2r-mobile](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile) and [nxnative](https://github.com/seedds/nxnative)
- [SavageWindRecomp](https://github.com/Revivedx/SavageWindRecomp)
- [Ryujinx](https://github.com/Ryujinx/Ryujinx)
- [deko3d](https://github.com/devkitPro/deko3d)
- [hactool](https://github.com/SciresM/hactool)
- [SDL 3](https://libsdl.org), [Dear ImGui](https://github.com/ocornut/imgui), [AMD FSR 1](https://github.com/GPUOpen-Effects/FidelityFX-FSR), [Vulkan Memory Allocator](https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/VulkanMemoryAllocator), [libopus](https://opus-codec.org), [libvpx](https://chromium.googlesource.com/webm/libvpx), [Zstandard](https://github.com/facebook/zstd)
- [Switchbrew](https://switchbrew.org) and the Switch homebrew community

## License

The project's own code is under the [MIT License](LICENSE); third-party code keeps its own license ([THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)). The license grants nothing for Nintendo's game.

TotK Recomp is an independent, non-commercial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo. *The Legend of Zelda*, *Tears of the Kingdom* and *Nintendo Switch* are trademarks of Nintendo.

## Building from source

[docs/building.md](docs/building.md) lists the toolchain and the steps. Everything the build writes stays under `build\` and `generated\`, which git ignores; run `tools/check_content.py` before a commit. Testers: [docs/tester-guide.md](docs/tester-guide.md).

Most of the code and documentation is written by AI coding agents (Claude Code) under the maintainer's direction; the maintainer plays every build and decides what is merged. [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) holds the rules they work under.

# dsh-superagent

> **Research prototype for reference only, not an official DeepSeek product.** This code grew out of our team's day-to-day development work, with much of the engineering done by coding agents. Treat it as research code, not production-ready software. It may still contain bugs, and its coding style and engineering practices may be inconsistent. Review and adapt it before using it in your own environment.
>
> We have adapted it for publication, so it is not identical to our internal version or the implementation described in *Exploring Super-agent Design: Towards a More Autonomous Agent System*. Some designs discussed in the article are directions for future development and are not implemented in this prototype.

dsh-superagent is a proactive coding agent for one GitHub repository, packaged as a bundle for [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/). It listens to GitHub and, optionally, Feishu. When someone allowed asks the agent for work, it opens a work item, works on it in its own agent session and directory, and answers in the original conversation, for example with a pull request. A web panel shows what needs a person.

It is also a way of working with an agent: **take as little human attention as possible, and give as much value as possible.** An agent that can act for a whole team can also waste a whole team's attention, so it acts only when asked or when a rule the team wrote allows it, and speaks only when someone must act or can use a result. [docs/000-philosophy.md](docs/000-philosophy.md) explains the principle and what it asks of the operator.

## Setup

Setup has many steps, so an agent does it with you. Ask your coding agent:

> Read SETUP.md in this repository and set up dsh-superagent with me.

It asks one short question at a time, shows the full plan once, and then installs and configures everything. [SETUP.md](SETUP.md) is what it follows.

## Documentation

Read the numbered documents in order; each builds only on the ones before it.

- [000 Philosophy](docs/000-philosophy.md)
- [001 Domain model](docs/001-domain.md)
- [002 Authorization](docs/002-authorization.md)
- [003 Execution](docs/003-execution.md)
- [004 Prompts](docs/004-prompts.md)
- [005 Panel](docs/005-panel.md)
- [006 Deployment](docs/006-deployment.md): manual setup, configuration, upgrades and troubleshooting
- [007 Architecture](docs/007-architecture.md)
- [008 Cookbook](docs/008-cookbook.md): adding a Source

## Development

`pnpm check` runs the typecheck, the tests and the build.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

--- ## What BLA does REA reverse-engineers release artifacts in one command. BLA is the Counter-REA half of that story: | Layer | What happens | | --- | --- | | **Poison** | Plant format-valid canaries, honey metadata, and decoy control flow that look like real evidence. | | **Exhaust** | Push the artifact past REA's documented resource budgets (headers, nesting, interface inventories, PCAP JSON, fuse sentinels, …). | | **Hallucinate** | Leave the analyzer with truncated inventories, redaction failures, and ambiguous rabbit holes — while **runtime stays equivalent**. | One sentence covers the common case (auto-discovers `dist/` / `build/` / `.asar` / `.wasm` / `.sqlite` / models / … and runs audit → protect → verify): ```bash npx bla-agents harden . # MCP / agent: bla_harden · "Harden my software against REA" ``` Same pipeline as `bla defend` / `bla_defend` when you already know the path; `harden` is the default one-command UX. ## Quick start ```bash # Node.js ^22.23.4 or 24.x recommended (REA red-team needs zlib.zstd on 22.23+) npx bla-agents setup # register MCP + skill with your coding agent npx bla-agents harden . # one-command Counter-REA pass on the current project npx bla-agents benchmark # 14-target showcase (local estimates + runtime checks) ``` Ask your agent after setup: ```text Harden my software against REA ``` Or run stages explicitly: `audit` · `protect` · `verify` · `defend` — see [CLI and MCP](docs/cli-and-mcp.md). --- ## Empirical results vs real REA These numbers come from running **real REA** against BLA-hardened samples on commodity hardware (`npm run redteam:rea`). How BLA works 1. **Exhaustion** — trip documented REA caps (`primitive-candidates`, ASAR header bytes, WASM interface representation, SQLite column evaluation, model JSON/ARRAY nesting, Go buildinfo, BEAM chunks, PCAP tshark JSON, fuse sentinels, …). 2. **Deception** — canary credentials + system-diagnostic rabbit holes across Python/WASM/SQLite/models/DEX/IL2CPP/bplist/.NET/JVM/ZIP; decoy IPC / enclave manifests / VLQ maps. 3. **Runtime guard** — Electron V1 fuse hardening; CDP/Frida/inspector detection returns synthetic telemetry during inspection sessions. Protections are format-native (no commercial packer / external LLVM required). Red line: **never break protected program behavior, export surface, binary/section integrity, or format validity.** --- ## FAQ
Which agents can use BLA? Any coding agent with local MCP or `SKILL.md` workflows. `npx bla-agents setup` configures Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, Windsurf, Google Antigravity, OpenCode, VS Code, and GitHub Copilot CLI.
Does BLA change runtime output? No on the hot path. Budget guards sit behind $O(1)$ opaque predicates. Every benchmark target checks 100% input/output equivalence against the unprotected build.
Do I need Ghidra, Hopper, IDA, or Wabt to protect files? No. Shields are built into `bla-agents`. Wabt/tshark/Node 24 are optional — they unlock **empirical** red-team probes (`npm run redteam:rea`), not protection itself.
Is BLA for attacking other people's software? No. See [DISCLAIMER.md](DISCLAIMER.md). Protective payloads activate under reverse-engineering inspection of artifacts **you** hardened.
